reason: A DeepSeek Harness web widget for visualizing conversation token usage and task costs, with currency conversion, pricing updates, and optional LLM-generated cost explanations.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时显示会话令牌用量、任务成本、定价和多币种信息的可视化组件，并支持生成任务成本说明。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness widget that visualizes real-time token usage, per-task costs, pricing, and multiple currencies, with optional generated cost explanations.

capabilities: reads session data to calculate per-task token usage and costs
displays pricing, token, currency, and task breakdown information
sends task information to an LLM for streamed cost explanations
fetches pricing and foreign-exchange data from external services
writes pricing and currency configuration to pricing.override.json
